summary: An excerpt from Book 10 (part 160) of a novel in which a man visits a real estate broker's office to discuss selling his loft apartment after a market downturn. The broker is frank and perceptive, estimates the sale price at about 1.8 million, and notes that the man bought the place for 200K-scale money and will likely lose a point or two after fees and taxes. He feels a pang of angry numbness, likes her candor, and dislikes talking about money, recalling that his partner Ria never discussed it either.
one_line: A man faces financial austerity as his broker candidly estimates his loft sale at about 1.8 million, leaving him a loss after fees.
key_facts: The broker says she sold the apartment eight years ago to the family who owned it before the man.
The broker estimates the apartment will sell for about 1.8 million, a number she says she can deliver.
The man says he has only 200K in the place, and the broker says he will break even or lose a little.
The man expects to be down a point or two after paying all the fees and taxes.
The man arrived at the broker's office by subway after coming straight from Ate's door.
The man describes himself as being on austerity measures, effective immediately.
The broker says the apartment came furnished and that the previous broker had likely changed it.
The broker says furnished stuff is never nice and that nice is antithetical to corporate, so inoffensive is the best one can hope for.
The broker offers to list the loft at 2 million or 2.2 million to make a later loft at 1.9 look like a steal, but the man declines.
The broker says the previous family sold to a corporate placement specialist via a different broker who did not mind such buyers.
The man feels some of his angry numbness ebb away and decides he likes the broker, who read him perfectly.
The man hates talking about money.
Ria never actually talks about money, only what money does.

entities.name: Ate
entities.role: person whose door the man came from before going to the broker's office

entities.name: Ria
entities.role: woman the man recalls never talking about money
